description: This Java source file defines the `WorkEffortServices` class, which provides a collection of service methods related to work efforts within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for retrieving assigned events, tasks, activities, and calendar entries, as well as handling work effort reminders and generating manufacturing summaries by facility. The class interacts extensively with the OFBiz entity engine, services, and calendar utilities to perform these operations.

classes.name: WorkEffortServices
classes.description: Provides services related to work efforts in OFBiz, including retrieval, scheduling, and summaries.

methods.name: getWorkEffortAssignedEventsForRole
methods.description: Retrieves work effort events assigned to a user role, filtered by current status, ordered by start date and priority.

methods.name: getWorkEffortAssignedEventsForRoleOfAllParties
methods.description: Retrieves work effort events for all parties with a specified role, excluding certain statuses.

methods.name: getWorkEffortAssignedTasks
methods.description: Fetches tasks assigned to the current user, considering status and assignment filters.

methods.name: getWorkEffortAssignedActivities
methods.description: Gets activities assigned to the current user with filtering on status.

methods.name: getWorkEffortAssignedActivitiesByRole
methods.description: Retrieves activities assigned to a user for a specific role.

methods.name: getWorkEffortAssignedActivitiesByGroup
methods.description: Retrieves activities assigned to a user by group.

methods.name: getWorkEffort
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific work effort, including permissions and current status.

methods.name: getWorkEffortEventsByPeriod
methods.description: Generates calendar entries for work efforts within a specified time period, handling recurring events and spanned periods.

methods.name: getProductManufacturingSummaryByFacility
methods.description: Provides a summary of manufacturing work efforts, including incoming and outgoing production runs, grouped by facility.

methods.name: processWorkEffortEventReminders
methods.description: Processes scheduled work effort reminders, sending notifications or updating reminder times.

methods.name: processWorkEffortEventReminder
methods.description: Handles sending a specific work effort event reminder, including email notifications.

methods.name: removeDuplicateWorkEfforts
methods.description: Removes duplicate work efforts from a list, ensuring unique entries.
